summary: Champion Homes, Inc. filed an 8-K furnishing Q1 FY2027 results and announcing a $50.0 million increase to its existing share repurchase program, refreshing the available amount to $150.0 million. The buyback authorization was approved by the Board of Directors on August 4, 2026. No specific price per share, premium, or expiration date were disclosed. The repurchase program is a return-of-capital event, representing an ongoing capital return initiative rather than a tender offer or special dividend. Watch for execution pace and potential impact on shares outstanding and EPS.
